text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Training for each event in preparation for 
the U.A.F. is finally underway, but—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I bet there's a whole lot 
you don't understand yet! Like, 'How on 
earth should I practice?!' and stuff!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
After all, the events in the "U.A.F." all 
have completely unique rules. Which means 
this will be everyone's first time taking 
on the challenge...!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"So, as a countermeasure! At Suzuka-san's 
suggestion, my contact information will be 
shared widely with all the athletes!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
If you have any questions about U.A.F. 
training, please don't hesitate to throw 
them all at me!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
I'll come running anytime, anywhere! 
Training together is more than welcome, 
too!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"Let's hone our skills together and make 
this a blazingly hot tournament!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Sonnet Elfie started offering her 
advice on training!
